detailed_description:
The target video uses realistic cinematic commercial photography with workplace light-comedy performance and the physical embodiment of internal personalities. The palette is dominated by cool grey, space grey, and black, with harsh red phone warnings and red floor digits as crisis accents. Lighting is high contrast while preserving natural Chinese skin texture and realistic perspiration. The output is 4K-quality, 16:9, with no subtitles and no non-diegetic music.

[Shot 1] A medium frontal shot establishes <Subject 5>, with the brushed-metal elevator doors centered in the premium technology-company lobby. <Subject 1> rushes toward the closing elevator from the front side of the frame, leaning forward while gripping his smartphone in one hand and securing the dark-grey document folder beneath his other arm. His jacket hem flaps and his slightly crooked tie shifts with each step. A stabilized camera tracks backward in front of him at fast speed, then pushes forward slightly as he turns sideways and squeezes through the doors at the final moment. Rapid footsteps, strained breathing, fabric movement, and the elevator closing chime are synchronized to his motion.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 1>'s smartphone held inside <Subject 6>. The screen dominates the frame, bordered by his tense fingers. The battery indicator clearly shows three percent in red. Notifications appear sequentially and remain legible: "我已经到会议室了", "PPT准备好了吗", and "你怎么不回消息？" A final red system warning reading "电量不足" overlays the screen. The camera remains at a fixed close distance but shakes slightly with each incoming notification. The phone vibrates repeatedly, followed by a sharp system warning sound.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, the camera tilts up rapidly from the phone to a low-angle medium close-up of <Subject 1> standing at the center of <Subject 6>. The recessed ceiling lights flicker with a faint electrical buzz. He raises his head and freezes. Around him, <Subject 2> forms on the left, <Subject 3> forms on the right, and <Subject 4> forms behind him, each beginning as a blurred residual image before becoming a distinct, fully solid person. The camera performs a small-amplitude arc around the group as all four preserve the same recognizable facial identity but remain clearly differentiated by hair, wardrobe, posture, and expression. <Subject 1> (S1), a tense Chinese male voice kept low and breathy, murmurs, <d>[Chinese] 不是吧……</d> His lips close immediately after the line.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.000, the camera trucks left toward <Subject 2> and then pushes in slowly. A medium two-shot places <Subject 2> on the left and <Subject 1> on the right, facing each other. <Subject 2> calmly straightens his black silk tie and adjusts his suit cuff, maintaining an exact corporate smile while cold sweat remains visible across his forehead. <Subject 2> (S2), speaking in an artificially composed Mandarin male voice, says, <d>[Chinese] 别回消息，保持神秘。</d> His lips close into the same professional smile. <Subject 1> turns toward him with visible confusion.

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to <Subject 3> suddenly lunging into a close-up at the center of the frame. His exaggerated face and tightly gripped phone dominate the foreground while <Subject 6> falls into slight motion blur behind him. The handheld camera rushes backward with strong shake and stops abruptly as he nearly reaches the lens. With wide eyes, raised brows, and rapid breathing, <Subject 3> (S3) shouts in a strained, high-energy Mandarin male voice, <d>[Chinese] 别点开！每亮一秒都是生命倒计时！</d> His suit and shirt scrape loudly as his shoulders jerk forward.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a high-angle wide shot looking down into <Subject 6>. <Subject 4> sits directly on the stone floor against the steel wall, isolated by empty cold metal space. He holds the phone loosely, with half-closed eyes and a collapsed posture. The camera pedestals down at slow speed and settles on his numb face. <Subject 4> (S4), speaking in a low, flat, slow Mandarin male voice, says, <d>[Chinese] 把亮度调到最低，人生也调到最低。</d> Only quiet fabric friction and his unhurried voice accompany the shot.

[Shot 7] At 00:07.000, an extreme close-up centers on <Subject 1>'s phone as he attempts to open the meeting presentation. The red warning "电量不足" appears again. The camera pulls out rapidly into a crowded medium shot and begins a slight handheld arc as <Subject 3>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 4> surround <Subject 1> from different directions. From behind him, <Subject 3> (S3) shouts, <d>[Chinese] 完了，客户要到了！</d> Immediately afterward, <Subject 2> leans close to his other side. <Subject 2> (S2) says with forced composure, <d>[Chinese] 我们可以说这是极简主义演示。</d> <Subject 4> remains against the rear wall with his eyes closed. The personas continue muttering over one another without introducing additional intelligible dialogue. <Subject 1> looks rapidly left and right as the framing becomes increasingly compressed and chaotic. Phone vibration, breathing, clothing movement, and overlapping voices fill the confined elevator.

[Shot 8] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> centered in the elevator. <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> press inward from the left and right edges while <Subject 4> remains low in the background. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward <Subject 1>'s sweating face. He inhales deeply and forces a professional smile, but the corner of his mouth twitches uncontrollably. Without opening his eyes, <Subject 4> (S4) says, <d>[Chinese] 建议装死。</d> <Subject 1>'s expression breaks. The camera stops moving as <Subject 1> (S1) shouts in exasperation, <d>[Chinese] 我只是想正常开个会！</d> His final word ends cleanly before the elevator arrival chime sounds. The red floor display glows above the crowded group as the video ends.
